South Shores Pet Clinic is my dream come true. I've lived in many parts of LA and visited many vets, but it's really something special when you find a vet you can trust, where they are a genuine part of the community, and provide affordable care by a loving and caring team. I've been in San Pedro now 2+ years and am so lucky to find them - they are the local version of Community Veterinary Hospital in Garden Grove which is the OCs family owned treasured and revered vet that I grew up. CVH in GG always has lines out the door and ppl coming from far away to see them. IYKYK.

SSPC is such a similar vibe. Family owned, caring accessible staff and doctors, and historic to the community - a reputable local vet with an interesting history serving the sea life at the aquarium and beaches back in the day!

What's better imo at SSPC is the access and convince. You can get same day appointments or drop off your pet in the morning for the docs and techs to assess and care for them right away.  I've easily gotten same day appointments for my pets, which CVH was always so hard to do and means waiting in line there for hours for your turn.

We also recently went through the sudden passing of one of our beloved cats. We took her in on a Friday because she very quickly went from healthy to barely moving and not eating. The vet was straight forward with us from the start but also hopeful. We hospitalized her with them over the weekend so she could get IV fluids to flush out what was in her system - something toxic - and retest her. They accommodated us visiting her for a long time, all 5 members of our family. They kept us updated, retested her, but sadly her body couldn't recover. They again let all 5 humans in our family come say goodbye, helped us clip some fur, and get her cremated. The staff sent us a lovely card with heartfelt messages.  I was scared of receiving the big bill, and while it was high, it was less than what I anticipated for all the time they had her and the care they provided.

We've also been there for well visits and sick visits. Each time the staff have been warm and so friendly. I absolutely love that it's a father and son operation, and the dad has great stories of his career in the San Pedro area over the decades. The nurses, techs, and clinicians/administrators have all been lovely and engaging. I feel at home there and appreciate so much what they do.

They truly are a "community" veterinary hospital/clinic that you can trust. Highly recommend.

Truly, I cannot express my gratitude to Dr. Weimer and his staff for the amazing service provided to our Frenchie, Coco. Coco was suffering from really bad allergies and itching but I was unable to get a quick appointment with her regular veterinarian. My neighbor had just returned with his dog from South Shores Clinic and was able to provide their information. In the meantime Coco started developing a fog over one of her eyes (she only has sight in one eye). I called South Shores in the morning and explained what was happening to Coco, and they worked her in for an afternoon appointment even though she had never been to the clinic before. A couple of hours before the appt Coco's eye filled up with blood and she went completely blind. Needless to say, I was frantic! We headed straight for the office and as soon as we checked in, his wonderful staff ushered Coco into a room and Dr. Weimer came right in to examine her. What an amazing doctor! Kind and compassionate, and he went to work immediately checking her eyes, medicating her eyes, and then providing other meds for her allergies. He then instructed us to follow up as soon as possible with eye care specialist. We got an appointment for the following day with the specialist and when Coco woke up on that day, she had her sight back. It turned out she had somehow punctured her cornea. I firmly believe that without Dr. Weimer's initial care, Coco would have been permanently blind. I am so grateful for his exceptional care, kindness and compassion. We will be taking Coco and our two other dogs to this clinic from now on. My only regret is that we didn't know about this clinic sooner. Thank you South Shores for your care, compassion and concern for my little girl and your awesome customer service!

I can't thank South Shores Pet Clinic enough for saving my 12 year old Chihuahua's life!

She rapidly developed the symptoms of pyometra, so I started calling nearby clinics. Because of the holiday weekend, most were closed or referred me to emergency hospitals. South Shores was able to provide a quote and perform her emergency spay the very same day.

After taking her home, she unfortunately declined over the weekend. I brought her back the following Monday morning and her lab results showed a very high white blood cell count + acute kidney failure. They quickly started IV fluids, antibiotics and hospitalized her. What was expected to be one night turned into three, but thankfully she was able to come home.

The entire staff was incredible! They kept me updated, welcomed me when I asked to visit and treated her with so much love and compassion. Dr. Wills even went to the butcher next door and got some chicken to encourage her to eat.

She's now home, recovering. I truly believe she wouldn't be here without their quick action and exceptional care. I'm forever grateful and highly recommend South Shores Pet Clinic to anyone looking for compassionate, fair, and lifesaving veterinary care. Thank you for saving my little girl, June! 💕
